material.text: The settings you just changed feed every configuration file abcd derives for this repository. A derived file that is not rebuilt keeps the old settings until the next install.

questions.ask: Should abcd rebuild the derived files now?

options.label: Rebuild every derived configuration file
options.meaning: Every file abcd derives is written again from the new settings. Files you edited by hand are left alone.

options.label: Keep the files unchanged
options.meaning: Nothing is written now. The files catch up at the next install.

later.label: Decide later
later.meaning: Nothing changes now. abcd asks again when the settings next change.

questions.now: the files hold the old settings
